# Bill Layne Insurance Agency
> Independent insurance agency in Elkin & Dobson, NC serving all 100 North Carolina counties since 2005. We compare rates from 9 carriers to find the best coverage at competitive prices.

## About
Bill Layne Insurance Agency is an independent insurance agency founded in 2005 by Bill Layne, a licensed North Carolina insurance agent (NC license #6571216) with 20+ years of experience. As an independent agency we represent multiple carriers and shop them against each other for every quote.

## Carriers We Represent
Auto insurance:
- Nationwide
- Progressive
- Travelers
- National General
- Foremost
- Dairyland

Home insurance:
- Nationwide
- Travelers
- Alamance Farmers Mutual
- NC Grange Mutual

Specialty lines:
- Hagerty (classic & collector car)
- Dairyland (motorcycle & ATV)
- Foremost (mobile & manufactured home)

## Services
- Auto Insurance (liability, comprehensive, collision, uninsured and underinsured motorist)
- Home Insurance (dwelling, personal property, liability, loss of use)
- Renters Insurance
- Motorcycle & ATV Insurance
- Commercial / Business Insurance
- Flood Insurance
- Umbrella Insurance
- Classic Car Insurance (Hagerty)

## Key Facts
- Licensed in all 100 NC counties (NC license #6571216)
- 4.9/5 Google rating with 127+ reviews
- Bilingual service (English & Spanish)
- NC minimum auto liability: 50/100/50 for policies issued or renewed on or after July 1, 2025
- Independent agency — not captive to one carrier
- Member of IIANC (Independent Insurance Agents of NC)
